plan: S1-007 / QA-QC-002: sample boxplots/densities and matching underlying data. This increment covers exactly two plots of one existing saved log2/None version; no normalization-before/after UI, PCA or broader QC claim.

inputs.parent: Complete previously validated saved preprocessing metadata; LFQ intensity, positive_only log2, normalization none, imputation none, zero and blank to_NA, pseudocount0. Full metadata/source/raw version and report/config/manifest provenance is retained, not replaced with a standalone Median result.
inputs.artifacts: All original11 persisted artifact bytes. Original canonical manifest name order is a fixed constant, never locale-sorted. digest::digest SHA256 and exact lengths checked before and after generation. Full saved working matrix and all four masks are decoded with raw row/sample identity preserved.
inputs.source_proof_boundary: Trusted coordinator validates metadata schema, Owner and storage before constructing parent. Generator verifies all artifact-byte pins but is not an Authority, registered runner, durable publisher or new ProcessedDatasetVersion.
inputs.numbers: Finite signed saved log2 values or exact NA token only. Log2 zero/negative values remain valid observations. NaN/Inf and malformed tokens refuse; no new log2/centering/scaling/imputation.
inputs.bounds: 1..10000 rows, at most64 displayed samples, <=2000000 selected cells, conservative estimated long-data bytes<=64MiB; output file<=32MiB and aggregate<=128MiB. Limits refuse the whole generation, never silently truncate.
inputs.output_dir: Absent private audit directory, not an existing publication destination. Partial private outputs can remain on failure; never auto-publish/delete/retry.

grouping.source: Only a previously persisted sample design for the exact same project, original dataset version and quantification family; complete exact name_raw/column_ordinal coverage and original order; all rows explicitly confirmed and nonblank group labels.
grouping.actual_design: 4cf9e303-46a1-4c04-969c-6400edc5490c was operator-read and validated by unchanged sample_design model against original import-report descriptors. Design hash and complete original saved record are retained.
grouping.no_inference: Never infer WT/100/treatment/control/group from sample names.
grouping.display_aliases: Group 1..k in original first-appearance order are ASCII display aliases. Exact raw saved group names, including Chinese text, remain in group-label-map.tsv, full long data, per-sample counts and full saved design provenance. No identity or condition is changed.
grouping.sample_identity: Full original sample names remain on the boxplot axis, density legend and data. Selected-matrix sample_ordinal and original source_column_ordinal are exported separately.
grouping.no_valid_design: Pass design=NULL and explicitly show Ungrouped. No made-up grouping. A supplied mismatching design refuses; caller must not silently repair it.

statistics.plot_filter: Only is.finite(saved_log2_intensity) is passed to plot statistics. Every original cell, including NA and all-missing rows/samples, remains in plot-long-data.tsv with all four original masks.
statistics.boxplot: ggplot2::geom_boxplot/stat_boxplot, coef1.5, standard package hinges/whiskers/outliers. No handwritten quartiles or outlier deletion. All native boxplot statistics including outlier values are exported.
statistics.density: ggplot2::geom_density/stat_density, Gaussian kernel, bw=nrd0, adjust1, n512, trimFALSE, one density per original sample. Standard stats::bw.nrd0 value exported for reproducibility; no handwritten density estimator.
statistics.density_eligibility: At least2 finite observations and2 distinct finite values per sample. Other samples are disclosed as insufficient_finite_n or constant_finite_values and omitted only from density statistics, not data/counts/identity. If no sample qualifies, whole operation refuses no_sample_density_estimable; no artificial curve is drawn.
statistics.NA: Excluded solely from plot statistics, never filled or changed. Per-sample observed, NA, original blank, original zero and imputed counts exported. Existing no-imputation input required.
statistics.native_stat_exports: Complete ggplot_build data for boxplot and density with original sample identity attached; computed once per plot. SVG draws the standard built gtable.

outputs.device: grDevices::svg,16x10 inches, family sans, Cairo; no custom vector graphics, PNG or PDF export
outputs.precision: Numeric exported values use %.17g, all original row/group/sample text retained. Complete parent and design/source bindings are saved in RDS and original metadata/design JSON is retained in actual audit evidence.
outputs.publication: Standalone scientific artifacts only; no HTTP/UI/download route, DB write, controlled job, registration or new saved version. Actual output SHA256 pins recorded by the finite target coordinator.

packages_and_environment.packages: ggplot2=4.0.3, digest=0.6.39, known /usr/local/lib/R/site-library; full sessionInfo retained. Package versions and DESCRIPTION facts are not a full-library code attestation.
packages_and_environment.invocation: Original native --vanilla --slave --file=<target> --args ...; clean original R_HOME/share/include/doc/library environment, thread counts1, profiles/environ disabled and private audit TMPDIR.
packages_and_environment.fonts: No font installation, registration, global font-file/config editing or new font engine. ASCII group display aliases avoid Chinese glyph requirements while preserving original mappings; original sample legend text retained. No visual-browser QA claimed.
